title: Relight · where a placed light lands
description: The Relight tool's Generate lighting on the same 12 portraits (local/relight/<id>.png): one white and one teal light at each of the 9 side x height spots, written by src/lib/relight/lights.ts. Light placement is measured from the aligned results with the tool's own maths (src/lib/relight/align.ts); identity, CLIP and aesthetic as in the relight suite. The tool's engine only.
decides: Whether the words alone put the light where it was placed, or the light-guide picture is needed (RELIGHT_SETTINGS.guide).

viggle.description: Generate lighting as the tool runs it: Viggle 6-step r256, the photo and the words only
